# Railroad renderer provenance

`railroad.js` is an unchanged copy of the renderer from
[tabatkins/railroad-diagrams, commit ea9a12393bbaa2c802b0449fd5bdf34b6868b83c](https://github.com/tabatkins/railroad-diagrams/blob/ea9a12393bbaa2c802b0449fd5bdf34b6868b83c/railroad.js).
Keeping the existing pinned source preserves the checked-in SVG output and permits
offline generation. Upstream's source attribution/license header and its repository
`LICENSE` file are retained verbatim. No package registry or remote module loader
is needed to run this renderer.

Source SHA-256: `9e193387ac94e8abb389528ef56d241f396efd95b016d9924fc61ea56ab55ac7`.
